notes.title: Attachment Update, Leveling and More Upcoming Features Showcase | NC:RD Season 3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38673399/23e08fc223c1cd9cc85f2f8c1b7db3e485dd22ce.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Everyone! The Upcoming New Season got more news! We got you players some new features on the multiplayer and the new co-op experience: [/b]

[h2]Multiplayer Update[/h2]

[h1]NEW ATTACHMENT SYSTEM[/h1]

[b]One new fresh attachment system is coming! Now you will be able to transform your gun the way that you like more: Increase Damage, RPM, Recoil Control, Range and more! 
Take a look on the full list of attachments:[/b]
[h3]SIGHTS:[/h3]
 - EO10 Red Dot Sight.
 - TM Mini Dot Sight.
 - Viper Reflex Sight.
 - EO10 Holographic.
 - Vortex Holographic.
 - TM 6X Optic.

[h3]MUZZLES:[/h3]
 - Compensator.
 - Flash Hider.
 - TM Light Supressor.
 - EO10 Tactical Supressor.
 - Colossus Supressor.
 - KKA Supressor (Only on 7.62/8 Rifles-12 Gauge Shotguns).

[h3]AMMO TYPES:[/h3]
 - Full Metal Jacket.
 - Stopping Power.
 - Light Rounds.
 - Burst Conversion (Auto Rifles).
 - Semi Conversion (Auto & Burst Rifles).
 - Weapon Bullet Conversion (Only on Supported Guns - Example: MK18[5.56, 9MM].
 - Weapon Auto Fire (PMM).
 - Slug Shot (Shotgun).
 - Bird Shot (Shotgun).

[h3]SKINS:[/h3]
 - Punk
 - Ruby
 - Arctic Camo
 - Forest Camo
 - Black Geometric
 - DWG.
 - Dragon's Skin
 - Orange Mess
 - Purple Rain
 - Element
 - Gold
 - Diamond

[b]All of the listed attachments will be present on all guns (Except the Sights).[/b]

[h1]NEW GAMEMODES[/h1]

[b]We've made new gamemodes and removed some others, take a look:[/b]

[h3]New Gamemodes:[/h3]
 - King Of The Hill (Gunfight Remake). (Upcoming YT Video).
 - Shotguns Only.

[h3]Removed Gamemode:[/h3]
 - Multi Team (Removed the Blackworns team).

[h1]NEW LEVELING SYSTEM[/h1]

[b]The Levels will be changed for all players, now it is harder to level up, but there will be present short Double XP Times and missions.[/b]

[h1]SOUND REDESIGN[/h1]

[b]We Remade almost all the sounds of the gun including: Weapon Fire sounds, Reload Sounds, Grenade Explosions, Ambient Sounds, Bullet Impact on metal and dirt, and Reverb.[/b]

[h1]NEW GUNS (Complete List)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38673399/27439cc18c3e25f479353d6b6b9004d7e7344da0.png[/img]

[b]Here's The New Weapons List:[/b]
 - N36 (LMG)
 - 1911 Remake (Pistol)
 - MK18 (Assault Rifle)
 - UMP45 (SMG)
 - .357 Remake (Pistol)
 - Stim (NonLethal)
 - P250 (Pistol)
 - AK12 Remake (Assault Rifle)
 - G36C Remake (Assault Rifle)
 - .50 GS Remake (Pistol)
 - PMM Remake (Pistol)
 - B23T Remake (Pistol)
 - Scorpion Remake (Pistol)

Also Removed:
 - MK18 5.56 (Old).
 - M249.

[h1]NEW UI[/h1]

[b]New Upcoming Fresh UI! Main Menu Changes, In-Game HUD and New Loading Screen.[/b]

----------------------------

[h2]CO-OP Dev Updates[/h2]

If you haven't watched the latest video, take a look! 

[previewyoutube=k8SpQg6Ddzs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]ELITE GUNS[/h1]

[b]The Elite Guns will be one Upgraded Version of the base ones (Only 3 Present Each Map) They will Have Different Attachments and Skins, And will cost a Huge Price (But it is worth!)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38673399/536d04a682cc8d5141f9b33bf455634b03de3c00.png[/img]
VPO 205 Elite (64K)

[h1]CO-OP Increase Amount Of Players[/h1]

[b]Now, 6 People will be able to play together, with 8 different Specialists.[/b]

- BlackHawk Games Team.

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames
